topic: Runner for allowed tools and pytest
what_happened: `uv run` would create an environment inside the audit worktree; `-p no:cacheprovider` makes pytest abort with 'Unknown config option: cache_dir' (budget row T01, exit 4, no test executed).
executor_decision: Tools run with the main checkout's .venv python (same uv.lock sha256) with cwd=audit worktree; pytest uses `-o cache_dir=<scratch>` instead of disabling the plugin; PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1. T01 stays in the test record as an invocation failure.
impact: 1 of 10 budget slots consumed without test execution. Some tools write ignored build/ files in the worktree (porcelain unchanged).

topic: Subagent slip in the audit worktree
plan_reference: plan section 4/5: subagents never write outside their shard; the worktree stays read-only
what_happened: Subagent a4_1 reported that an unquoted shell redirection created a 4-byte file `agents/applications` in the audit worktree; it removed the file immediately and `git status` was clean afterwards. The parent verified porcelain empty after the event (check C11). Later subagent prompts forbid shell redirections and file creation in the worktree.
executor_decision: Recorded as a process finding; no evidence was derived from the stray file.
impact: None on the dossier; relevant to the claim 'read-only'.

topic: Budget run T05 consumed by an invocation error
plan_reference: plan section 8: bounded pytest runs with explicit node ids
what_happened: Run T05 named a test file path that does not exist (the STATE-X closed-world test lives in tests/qualification/state_x/_state_x_final_r1_closed_world_tests.py); pytest exited 4 ('file or directory not found') and no test ran. The run stays in the record (T01 and T05 are both invocation failures: 2 of 10 slots with exit 4, no test executed).
executor_decision: Reported as is; node ids are now verified with git grep before a run.
impact: Effective executed-test budget: 8 slots at most (T02, T03, T04, T06 executed so far).

topic: Finding ID allocation defect in the executor tooling
plan_reference: plan A9-T01: keep IDs, add merged_into; C07 finding completeness
what_happened: The stable-ID allocator in tools/fl.py ignored previously assigned shard IDs and parent-authored IDs, so 19 shard findings received IDs already used by other findings (found by a uniqueness check on 2026-11-15 during W3). The allocator was fixed (it now considers all assigned IDs) and the 19 later-assigned findings were re-numbered; every reference made earlier (seeds, overrides) was checked to point at the intended finding. IDs printed in chat before the fix for shard findings may therefore differ from the final IDs for the 19 moved findings (EQOA-A2-007..010, A2-014..016, A2-018, A2-022/023 for B1/B3/B4/B5 findings, EQOA-A1-006/007, A3-005/006, A4-008, A5-007..009 for the A5-2 batch).
executor_decision: Fixed and recorded; check C07 (and a new uniqueness assertion) guard against recurrence.
impact: None on the content; the auditor should use the final FINDINGS.jsonl.
gap_note: Gaps in the final ID sequence (e.g. EQOA-A2-003, A2-005, A4-001) are placeholder findings of seeds that were later merged into other findings or refuted (S-11, S-18, S-12; S-17 and S-19 likewise); the seed registry keeps removed_placeholder_finding_id.
